component: ComfyUI Windows portable variants, Ollama Windows runtime, Qwen3 4B text model, and Stable Diffusion 1.5 FP16 image checkpoint
release_blockers: Review the completed v0.46.0 inventory evidence for all four official Windows portable variants; automated inventory is not legal approval.

Resolve remaining packages with missing or ambiguous METADATA license fields (initial inventory: 14 in NVIDIA, 14 in NVIDIA CUDA 12.6, 17 in AMD, 14 in Intel); comfy-aimdo 0.6.0 upstream GPL-3.0 is now identified, but exact bundled wheel/source and notice inclusion still require verification.

Review copyleft and notice obligations identified in the inventories, including comfyui-embedded-docs GPL-3.0, pygit2 GPLv2 with linking exception, autocommand LGPLv3, certifi MPL-2.0, and tqdm MPL-2.0 AND MIT.
Review Intel Simplified Software License terms for the Intel oneAPI/MKL/TBB/Tcmlib components in the Intel portable variant.

Review every redistributable native runtime binary and its owner/license; the automated inventory now filters by native-binary extensions and known runtime-library filename markers, but this heuristic is not a complete binary ownership or license determination.
Collect exact license texts, copyright notices, attribution requirements, and source-offer/source-code obligations for each bundled component.

Review the exact 7-Zip executable's included components against the composite LGPL, unRAR restriction, BSD and public-domain terms; the matching source archive and license text are included and hash-checked by the installer.
Complete Ollama Windows amd64 runtime dependency inventory and exact Qwen3 4B manifest/blob digest and license review.
Have all software, model, trademark, export, and redistribution obligations reviewed before any public or customer distribution.

Verify the installed-app CreativeML Open RAIL-M full-text display and persisted click-through acceptance gate, preserve paragraph 5 restrictions for every model user, and complete legal review before any public/customer distribution.

Review comfyui-frontend-package 1.59.6's exact 30.1 MB wheel frontend assets and embedded third-party licenses; the bundled METADATA has no license declaration, classifier, project URL or license files, and PyPI reports no provenance.

For comfy-aimdo 0.6.0, verify the exact installed Windows wheel digest and include/provide corresponding GPL-3.0 source; the portable artifacts do contain the 36,091-byte dist-info LICENSE file, but that is not the corresponding source.
Resolve the AMD ROCm 7.2.1 rocm, rocm-sdk-core and rocm-sdk-libraries-custom packages' exact Windows component licenses and proprietary runtime terms; AMD licenses ROCm components individually.

For comfyui-frontend-package 1.59.6, retain the upstream GPL-3.0-only license and corresponding source, then enumerate all frontend npm dependency and asset notices from the exact wheel/build; the PyPI wheel and sdist have no provenance metadata.
